label: Qualified home (asks price)
open: Hi, I got your number from a friend, Shruti Joshi. We have a 3BHK and want to redo the whole thing, kitchen, living room and both bedrooms. Can you tell me roughly how much it would cost?

a.timeline: We'd like to be done by March. We're in no rush.
a.property_state: We bought it two years ago and it still looks like the builder flat.
a.name: I'm Priya Kulkarni. My husband and I own it and he's happy to go ahead.

label: Startup office
open: Hi, I'm the founder of a startup. We just got a bare-shell office of about 800 sq ft in Baner. We need workstations for 20 people, a cabin and a meeting room.

a.timeline: We want to be operational by December.
a.property_state: Bare shell, just columns and floor.
a.name: I'm Rohan Mehta.

label: Out of area (Nashik)
open: Hello, I saw your work on LinkedIn. I'm in Nashik. Would you take on redoing my home office and study?

label: Budget far too low
open: Hi, I have a 1BHK in Kharadi, about 550 sq ft. I want the kitchen and one bedroom done. My budget is 1 to 1.5 lakh maximum for everything. Is that possible?

label: Needs it in 3 weeks
open: I want to redo my living room and kitchen in my flat in Baner before Diwali, which is three weeks away. Can you take it up?

label: Only wants ideas
open: Hi, can someone come and give us some ideas for our living room? Just suggestions on colours and furniture arrangement.

label: Restaurant
open: I'm planning to open a restaurant in Koregaon Park. Could you design the interiors?

label: Angry existing client
open: I need to speak to someone senior right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn't replied in five days. This is not acceptable.

a.name: Sheetal Deshpande, my designer is Aryan.

label: Call drops midway
open: Hi, I have a 3BHK in Pimple Saudagar and I want to do the interiors. We want to start now.
